text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's a crazy lineup,
huh!? I was just my usual wicked self and 
the word spread like wildfire☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-paisen, Ban-chamu, Yae-mero…… 
Kuuuu～ it really gets you fired up!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Anyway,
it means this race is gonna be extra
spicy! 
Uhyaa, I'm pysched～☆ Crazy～☆

Daitaku Helios hadn't even debuted yet.
No matter how much 
hidden talent she had,
against experienced opponents like this……

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Don't be such a downer～. 
'Sides, looky there!

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Uwa, seriously!?
Helios-chan's runnin' in a mock race 
that looks like a G1.
So the group LANE wasn't lying……

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Really,
I have no idea what that girl's thinking…… But,
an 
opportunity like this doesn't come around
often. I need to properly analyze it!

text_block_list.name: Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Helios～～～～!! You're our Blitz Captain～～!! 
You better not lose to them when it comes
to guts～～～～!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah! Just watch me～☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
See? They're all chompin' at the bit too! 
Got no choice but to take the reins!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
'Sides, results? 
―We won't know 'til it's over!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well, just sit back and relax～! 
Heli-poyo is gonna knock this Wei～ outta
the park☆ Let's go!

If she's like that in front of this line
up, then just maybe…… that means she was
confident 
enough that she purposefully gathered
them!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ―Hell yeah, pedal to the metal～～～～!!!!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Ooooooh……!?
Daitaku Helios leapt out in front! 
And she just keeps on accelerating……!

Daitaku Helios was running at a speed that
seemed like she wasn't 
even thinking about pacing herself,
she just continued to pull 
further ahead. And that's not all――

text_block_list.name: Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Gyahahaa, keep it up Helios!! 
Red-line it～～～～!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You got it～～!! 
You better kick it up over there too～～～～!!
Ahahaa!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
She's got enough leeway…… to hold a
conversation!? That girl, 
don't tell me…… she's seriously planning to
run away with this? 
Against those opponents……!?

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaah～……

In the end,
she couldn't recover from that……

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Zeeeeh…… Haaa…… Ugh, gonna puke…… 
And I was last～…… Haa～～…… Seriously,
seriously―

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
―Seriously,
that was hilarious!! Wahahaha～!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to push through to the end
though～. 
Knew it,
I just didn't have the stamina! Fuha☆
choice_data_list: You had no chance from the start!?
You had no chance from the start!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, there was no way! But,
I had a blast!♪ 
I just love racing～! Good work,
me! Good work everyone～!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Haa, I was worried there.
Daitaku Helios…… Fufuu, what an 
interesting girl. But,
well…… teaming up with her…… is a bit
much.

text_block_list.name: Experienced Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Talking to the spectators during the race……
it's almost like she 
has no ability to focus.
A girl that only wants to perform, I 
wouldn't want to face her……

text_block_list.name: Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Helios, you really are insane～!
You gotta do something fun like 
this again.
Haven't you been offline kind of often
lately?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I have～!! We should fix that! 
LANE me!! See ya～☆

She had just come in last,
but I didn't sense any sense of 
frustration from Daitaku Helios at all.
Of course, she was 
probably down about it, but……
choice_data_list: Um, aren't you…… a little upset?
Um, aren't you…… a little upset?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaa, about that～! 
Nope, not one bit☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well,
it would have been awesome if I won! 
Losing isn't gonna pull me down,
though. No regrets!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it was super fun,
right!? Everyone was all smiles! 
And I was～ awesome!
Ain't nothing to be down about～, right!?

It wasn't a front at all, she,
from the bottom of 
her heart…… was laughing.
I never thought I'd meet 
a student here that was so outside the
norm.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's up with your palm!? 
Isn't it really red?

When I looked,
my fingernails had left marks in my palm.
"She 
might win!" ……when I had been thinking that,
I must have 
unintentionally clenched my fists.
choice_data_list: (Right, I was excited for her. But……)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
……Ah, I just remembered something! 
We were talking about contracts,
right? What do you want to do―

text_block_list.name: Friend C
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Heli～! We're heading to a family 
restaurant with Jordan, wanna come～?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I'll go――!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hnya?

I had gotten to see her run but,
I still didn't have a clear 
understanding of her. At the very least,
I wanted to hear what 
she wanted to focus on―
choice_data_list: Do you have a dream you want to fu...
Do you have a dream you want to fu...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
A never-ending festival! 
Byeeee～☆

―Her run was very promising.
She could probably 
make big things happen,
that's what I felt. But……

There was no good or bad when it came to
dreams. 
But if I was going to be her trainer,
I wanted 
her to be able to aim for it seriously.

A clash of serious emotions was what made
races awe-inspiring. 
With the way she is now,
I couldn't sense any sense of 
"seriousness" in her……
choice_data_list: (I need to know more about her)

text_block_list.text:
And so, on the next day off.
I went in to the city to find 
Daitaku Helios…… I found her almost
immediately, and she seemed 
to be in a good mood.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You came at just the right time! 
You free? Wanna dance!?
